title: A Pet of My Own
offer: Our cat had five kittens, and Mother says we can keep only one. Would you take the little grey one? It purrs like a drum! Row it home to your farm.

steps.load_say: Here she is. Hold her basket tight, she wants to see the fish!

steps.say: A kitten! She can sleep by the fire and catch the mice in the grain. What a good little sailor.

reward.gift: a kitten who rides in the bow

fact: Cats were loved on viking farms: they kept the mice away from the grain.
